# RealWorld2's API classes call a static Base.on/fire that no class provides

## Context

The middleware's full SSG rebuild (pages `5df4094`, `neo.mjs` 13.2.0) failed on one route and aborted the deploy chain:

```
Error rendering route /apps/realworld2/index.html: TypeError: Base.on is not a function
    at Favorite.onConstructed (…/neo.mjs/apps/realworld2/api/Base.mjs:60:18)
    at Object.setupClass (…/neo.mjs/src/Neo.mjs:1034:23)
    at …/neo.mjs/apps/realworld2/api/Favorite.mjs:41:20
Static HTML generation completed with 1 failed route(s): /apps/realworld2/index.html
```

Earlier middleware runs were incremental with no content delta, so the route was never re-rendered. This full rebuild exposed it.

## The Problem

`apps/realworld2/api/Base.mjs` `onConstructed()` coordinates its API singletons through static events on the class. The first instance reads the token and calls `Base.fire('ready', token)`; every later instance calls `Base.on({ready: me.onReady, scope: me})`. `static observable = true` applies `Neo.core.Observable` to the prototype only, and `Observable` defines no static `on` or `fire`, as `src/core/Observable.mjs` shows. Every API singleton after the first therefore throws on construction, and the first throws when its token read resolves. The demo cannot boot, in a browser or in SSR.

## The Architectural Reality

- `apps/realworld2/api/Base.mjs`: `initialTokenRequestSent`, `Base.fire`, `Base.on`.
- `src/Neo.mjs` `setupClass()`: `static observable` pushes `Neo.core.Observable` into the instance mixins.

## The Fix

One shared static token promise. The first construction creates it from the `LocalStorage` read, and every instance chains `onReady` onto it. This drops the static-event handshake and `initialTokenRequestSent`. Instance-level observability stays as it is.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A unit arm, red before the fix: constructing two API classes calls each `onReady` exactly once, with the stored token, and nothing throws.
- [ ] The RealWorld2 app boots in a browser.
- [ ] Post-release (13.3 and a `pages` bump): the middleware renders `/apps/realworld2/index.html`.

## Out of Scope

- The middleware's policy of aborting the whole deploy on one failed route. That is its owner's decision.
